Added `libs/mngr_autocompact` to the public mirror. It is a publishable package (absent from `UNPUBLISHED_PACKAGES`) that the default workspace template installs and runs, but it had no allowlist entry, so the public repo carried its command docs without its source. The public overlay gains its `--cov` flag and a regenerated `uv.lock`. New tests in `scripts/release_test.py` fail when a publishable lib is missing from the allowlist or the overlay's `--cov` flags drift from the mirrored libs and apps.

Brought the mirror docs up to date with the live sync: `mirror/README.md` no longer describes the export as disabled, replaces the completed enable-blocker checklist with current operational notes, and documents the three edits that adding a lib to the mirror takes. `mirror/pypi_trusted_publishers.md` now lists `imbue-mngr-autocompact` and describes steady-state publisher setup. The public-mirror spec records the cutover and names every private lib and app, and the allowlist and overlay `pyproject.toml` comments no longer make claims that had gone stale.
